name: portal-reference
description: Reference monorepo for the Portal micro-frontend platform (host, remotes, platform packages, mock backends, CLI).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n tasks,legacy,host -c green,yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter tasks-remote dev" "pnpm --filter legacy-remote dev" "pnpm --filter host dev"
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n tasks,legacy,host -c green,yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter tasks-remote preview" "pnpm --filter legacy-remote preview" "pnpm --filter host preview"
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify
